body_lead: UP govt plans nearly ₹600 crore investment to strengthen AI ecosystem To achieve its objectives, the state is scaling up infrastructure for technologies such as AI, Quantum Computing, and deep-tech innovations premium Listen to This Article To position Uttar Pradesh (UP) as a leading artificial intelligence (AI) hub in South Asia, the state government has committed to invest almost ₹600 crore.
